# EduWork Knowledge Studio core

Source: https://github.com/ECNU/EduWork/tree/d1943988c44ef3dfcfe0eed54808d86b9d5a3ff3/packages/dsh-knowledge-studio/lib

`parser.js`, `tokenizer.js`, `mindmap.js`, `evidence-labels.js` are unmodified copies from this pinned commit.
Copyright (c) 2026 East China Normal University. MIT license is included alongside the modules.

Campulse supplies PocketBase ownership, protected-file reads, ChatECNU model routing,
artifact validation and mobile interactions in `../../notebook.mjs`.
The desktop Host and its process protocol remain a separate deployment architecture.
